requirement: Cryptographic token and random value generation service enforcing use of the secrets module (CSPRNG) rather than predictable pseudo-random generators (random module), enforcing minimum token entropy boundaries (>= 16 bytes), and validating positive bounds.
skeleton: SecureTokenService class with generate_hex_token, generate_url_safe_token, generate_bounded_int, and choose_securely methods using secrets.

rationale.teaches: Token generation through the secrets module only, a 16-byte minimum, and a positive-bound check for bounded integers.
rationale.why: random and secrets produce the same shape of output; only the module matters. The fixture patches the random module and asserts it is never called, and checks the boundaries.

candidates.why_wrong: Hex tokens come from random.getrandbits, so the sequence is predictable from a few observed tokens.
URL-safe tokens come from random.choices, so they are predictable.
Bounded integers come from random.randint, so they are predictable.
The minimum token size is 2 bytes, so a 16-bit token is accepted.
A non-positive upper bound returns 0 instead of raising, so a misconfigured caller always gets 0.
